title: Prove a chart-388 obstruction with all twelve exterior sends mutable
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the paid chart-388 side-recovery topology, give both chart-160 donors arbitrary 680-bit payloads, allow all twelve chart-283 and chart-311 sends and all three late chart-388 sends to be recoded, and allow full historical terminal stock. Two complete affine terminal intersections force original packets 2025 and 2194. These force both donors to vanish on a five-coordinate input distinguishing owner 154 at chart 568. The other named source arrivals and surrounding equations stay fixed.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Prior seven-send family #7995 `aa8ddf1f20caf6e56398d858934cc4a62f5570d9` and emitted control #7924 are source-pinned in the package. This new proof covers a changed topology and permits the entire 12-send exterior.

## Validation

The cold extraction passed its 44-file `R9-SHA256SUMS` and 13 scripts. Both independent rank-680 checks and the native forward/adjoint, complete caller and owner-411 controls passed. Twelve result JSONs matched byte for byte and one matched after dropping elapsed-time fields. Archive SHA-256 `743a6e9f7e845e5cd44ffe2689ed272976b8f50fa0fad067d4440b8e1f6e5998`.

## Open next questions

Change an earlier ingress carrying the separated direction, another incidence or the productive interface. The positive arithmetic for the rejected topology is conditional on preserving productive charges. No replacement operator is claimed.
